text:
mohit: Quick triage: alert from SIEM - partner analytics index contains long base64 blobs and a service account email. Looks like decrypt was allowed cross-project. Posting sample (redacted) path: gs://partner-analytics/2026-06-14/events.log

rachel: Can you paste the example line and the sa email (redacted)? Need to scope.

mohit: `... "sa_email": "ingest-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com", "blob": "CiQAMTI...==" ...` 

sec-bot: automated-alert: KMS audit shows DECRYPT by principal `analytics-forwarder@partner-xyz.iam.gserviceaccount.com` on key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/prod-keys` at 2026-06-14T12:03:22Z. Ticket SEC-4517 created.

tara: If partner had DECRYPT role, they could have obtained plaintext. We need containment: remove decrypt binding, snapshot evidence, and rotate affected SA keys. Who can remove the binding now?

dev-ops-bot: executing: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding prod-keys --location=global --keyring=infra --project=redwood --member=serviceAccount:analytics-forwarder@partner-xyz.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`

dev-ops-bot: done. Policy snapshot -> gs://forensic-2890012345/key-policy.json (ACL: security-only).

rachel: Good. Tara, can you map which secrets used that key? I'll search Vault exports for wrapped ciphertexts with that key header.

tara: Running grep now. Found ~9 secrets under secret/data/partner-ingest/* that were wrapped with that key within the 48h window. Listing names to forensic bucket (names only).

mohit: Start rotation: 1) generate new key version and rewrap secrets to v2 2) rotate service account keys for listed SAs 3) revoke any long-lived tokens. I'll own SA rotations.

sec-bot: automated-update: containment: binding removed, evidence captured. Next: KMS rewrap plan and SA key rotation.

rachel: Legal question: partner contract retention clause prevents asking for deletion without legal approval. @legal please advise before we request partner scrub.

legal: On it. We can request partner to quarantine the objects and avoid deletion until we complete forensic review. We'll draft the message.

tara: Tech note: rewrapping will not retroactively prevent earlier decrypts. Because partner had decrypt rights, assume compromise. We'll rotate affected SA keys and force short TTLs for new tokens.

mohit: Rotation commands queued. Running `./runbooks/rewrap-secrets.sh --key prod-keys --from v1 --to v2` in dry-run first.

rachel: Also add an immediate ingestion rule to redact any JSON fields matching /(private_key|private_key_id|client_email)/ before forwarding to external partners. Open PR to infra.

mohit: Dry-run results: rewrap successful for 9 items, no consumer failures in dry-run. Scheduling full run in maintenance window.

legal: Draft ready for partner outreach. Will ping sec-4517 channel once sent. Ask them to preserve and not delete for 7 days.

dev-ops-bot: executing SA key rotate for `ingest-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. New key created and old key disabled. Secrets updated in secret-store.

rachel: Confirmed CI and runners updated. KMS rewrap scheduled for 2026-06-15 02:00 UTC. Postmortem scheduled 2026-06-16 16:00 UTC.

tara: Follow-ups: 1) add unit test in ingest pipeline preventing SA JSON; 2) add IAM guardrail to flag cross-project decrypt bindings during PR; 3) run org-wide scan for similar bindings.

mohit: Taking 1+2. rachel will take 3. Thanks team. Keep updates in #sec-4517.
